license_required.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice medicine in this State.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Physicians.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Physicians.

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Physicians.

age_minimum.quote: The applicant shall be at least 18 years old.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good moral character.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy
degree_required.quote: Have a degree of doctor of medicine from a medical school that is accredited by an accrediting organization that the Board recognizes in its regulations

accrediting_body.value: Accrediting organization recognized by the Board in its regulations
accrediting_body.quote: from a medical school that is accredited by an accrediting organization that the Board recognizes in its regulations

required.quote: Submit evidence acceptable to the Board of successful completion of 1 year of training in a postgraduate medical training program that is accredited by an accrediting organization that the Board recognizes in its regulations

duration.quote: successful completion of 1 year of training in a postgraduate medical training program

kind.quote: 1 year of training in a postgraduate medical training program that is accredited by an accrediting organization that the Board recognizes in its regulations

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Applicant must attain a passing score as set by the Board; alternatively may hold a certificate of proficiency from NBME or other recognized boards
exams.quote: Attain on the federation licensing examination or the United States Medical Licensing Examination a passing score as set by the Board under its rules and regulations

exams.name: Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX)
exams.quote: Attain on the federation licensing examination or the United States Medical Licensing Examination a passing score as set by the Board under its rules and regulations

interval_years.quote: The term of a license issued by the Board may not exceed 3 years.

required.quote: the Board may establish continuing education requirements as a condition to the renewal of licenses under this section.

available.quote: The Board shall license an applicant to practice medicine if the applicant: Became licensed or certified as a physician in another jurisdiction under requirements that the Board determines are substantially equivalent to the licensing requirements of this title

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another jurisdiction under substantially equivalent requirements, be in good standing, submit application, pay fee, and the other jurisdiction must offer similar reciprocal licensing for Maryland licensees.
requirements.quote: Became licensed or certified as a physician in another jurisdiction under requirements that the Board determines are substantially equivalent to the licensing requirements of this title; Is in good standing under the laws of the other jurisdiction

regulatory_model.quote: a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice medicine in the State unless licensed by the Board

credential_type.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to practice medicine.

is_mandatory.quote: a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice medicine in the State unless licensed by the Board

title_protection.quote: a person may not use the words or terms "Dr.", "doctor", "physician", "D.O.", or "M.D." with the intent to represent that the person practices medicine, unless the person is: Licensed to practice medicine under this title

scope_protection.quote: a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice medicine in the State unless licensed by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or licensee or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively uses a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral or unprofessional conduct in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of: Immoral conduct in the practice of medicine; or Unprofessional conduct in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being professionally, physically, or mentally incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is professionally, physically, or mentally incompetent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting or advertising in violation of the statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicits or advertises in violation of § 14–503 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandons a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitually being intoxicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitually is intoxicated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being addicted to or habitually abusing any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is addicted to, or habitually abuses, any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance as defined in § 5–101 of the Criminal Law Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing professional services while under the influence of alcohol or drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Provides professional services: While under the influence of alcohol; or While using any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promoting the sale of drugs or goods to a patient to exploit the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotes the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods to a patient so as to exploit the patient for financial gain

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing a false report or record in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully makes or files a false report or record in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to file or record any medical report as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully fails to file or record any medical report as required under law, willfully impedes or obstructs the filing or recording of the report, or induces another to fail to file or record the report

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide details of a patient's medical record on proper request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: On proper request, and in accordance with the provisions of Title 4, Subtitle 3 of the Health – General Article, fails to provide details of a patient's medical record to the patient, another physician, or hospital

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting professional patronage through an agent or profiting from acts of a person represented as an agent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicits professional patronage through an agent or other person or profits from the acts of a person who is represented as an agent of the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or accepting any sum for bringing or referring a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pays or agrees to pay any sum to any person for bringing or referring a patient or accepts or agrees to accept any sum from any person for bringing or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a willful misrepresentation in treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Makes a willful misrepresentation in treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine with an unauthorized person or aiding an unauthorized person in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices medicine with an unauthorized person or aids an unauthorized person in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Grossly overutilizing health care services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Grossly overutilizes health care services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, treatment, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offers, undertakes, or agrees to cure or treat disease by a secret method, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by a licensing or disciplinary authority or convicted in any state or country for an act that would be grounds for discipline in Maryland
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is disciplined by a licensing or disciplinary authority or convicted or disciplined by a court of any state or country or disciplined by any branch of the United States uniformed services or the Veterans' Administration for an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet appropriate standards as determined by peer review for delivery of quality medical and surgical care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to meet appropriate standards as determined by appropriate peer review for the delivery of quality medical and surgical care performed in an outpatient surgical facility, office, hospital, or any other location in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully submitting false statements to collect fees for services not provided
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully submits false statements to collect fees for which services are not provided

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrendering or allowing a license to lapse while under investigation for an act that would be grounds for discipline
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Was subject to investigation or disciplinary action by a licensing or disciplinary authority or by a court of any state or country for an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under this section and the licensee: Surrendered the license issued by the state or country to the state or country; or Allowed the license issued by the state or country to expire or lapse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to report suspected child abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly fails to report suspected child abuse in violation of § 5–704 of the Family Law Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to educate a patient being treated for breast cancer of alternative methods of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to educate a patient being treated for breast cancer of alternative methods of treatment as required by § 20–113 of the Health – General Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, prescribing, giving away, or administering drugs for illegal or illegitimate medical purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sells, prescribes, gives away, or administers drugs for illegal or illegitimate medical purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing or discriminating against an individual in providing professional services because the individual is HIV positive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refuses, withholds from, denies, or discriminates against an individual with regard to the provision of professional services for which the licensee is licensed and qualified to render because the individual is HIV positive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the CDC's guidelines on universal precautions except in emergency life-threatening situations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except in an emergency life–threatening situation where it is not feasible or practicable, fails to comply with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's guidelines on universal precautions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to display the required notice regarding CDC universal precautions guidelines
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to display the notice required under § 14–415 of this subtitle

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board or a disciplinary panel
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board or a disciplinary panel

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of insurance fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of insurance fraud as defined in § 27–801 of the Insurance Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being in breach of a service obligation resulting from receipt of State or federal funding for medical education
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is in breach of a service obligation resulting from the applicant's or licensee's receipt of State or federal funding for the licensee's medical education

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making a false representation when seeking or making application for licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully makes a false representation when seeking or making application for licensure or any other application related to the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: By corrupt means, threats, or force, intimidating or influencing any person to withhold or change testimony before the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: By corrupt means, threats, or force, intimidates or influences, or attempts to intimidate or influence, for the purpose of causing any person to withhold or change testimony in hearings or proceedings before the Board or a disciplinary panel

disciplinary_grounds.description: By corrupt means, threats, or force, hindering any person from making information available to the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: By corrupt means, threats, or force, hinders, prevents, or otherwise delays any person from making information available to the Board or a disciplinary panel in furtherance of any investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally misrepresenting credentials for the purpose of testifying or rendering an expert opinion before the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally misrepresents credentials for the purpose of testifying or rendering an expert opinion in hearings or proceedings before the Board or a disciplinary panel

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep adequate medical records as determined by appropriate peer review
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to keep adequate medical records as determined by appropriate peer review

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing a cosmetic surgical procedure in an office or facility that is not accredited or certified to participate in Medicare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performs a cosmetic surgical procedure in an office or a facility that is not: Accredited by: The American Association for Accreditation of Ambulatory Surgical Facilities; The Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care; or The Joint Commission on the Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations; or Certified to participate in the Medicare program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to submit to a criminal history records check
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to submit to a criminal history records check under § 14–308.1 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the title, any rule or regulation adopted by the Board, or any State or federal law pertaining to the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates any provision of this title, any rule or regulation adopted by the Board, or any State or federal law pertaining to the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the requirements of the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to comply with the requirements of the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program under Title 21, Subtitle 2A of the Health – General Article.

definition_quote.value: "Practice medicine" means to engage, with or without compensation, in medical: Diagnosis; Healing; Treatment; or Surgery.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice medicine" means to engage, with or without compensation, in medical: Diagnosis; Healing; Treatment; or Surgery.

value: diagnosing, healing, treating, preventing, prescribing for, or removing any physical, mental, or emotional ailment
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice medicine" includes doing, undertaking, professing to do, and attempting any of the following: Diagnosing, healing, treating, preventing, prescribing for, or removing any physical, mental, or emotional ailment or supposed ailment of an individual; Ending of a human pregnancy; and Performing acupuncture as provided under § 14–504 of this title.

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs; the Board may adopt rules and regulations regarding the dispensing of prescription drugs by a licensed physician.
drug_authority.quote: After consulting with the State Board of Pharmacy, adopt rules and regulations regarding the dispensing of prescription drugs by a licensed physician

license_status_types.quote: The Board may place a licensee on inactive status ... The Board may place a licensee on emeritus status

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must be certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG), pass a qualifying examination for foreign medical school graduates, and complete 2 years of training in an accredited postgraduate medical education program (or complete a fifth pathway program plus 2 years of postgraduate training).
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Is certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or by its successor as approved by the Board; Passes a qualifying examination for foreign medical school graduates required by the Board

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Submit evidence acceptable to the Board of successful completion of 1 year of training in a postgraduate medical training program that is accredited by an accrediting organization that the Board recognizes in its regulations

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Physicians must prescribe the lowest effective dose of an opioid and a quantity no greater than needed for the expected duration of pain, unless treating a substance-related disorder, cancer pain, end-of-life/hospice/palliative care, or chronic pain.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: On treatment for pain, a health care provider, based on the clinical judgment of the health care provider, shall prescribe: The lowest effective dose of an opioid; and A quantity that is no greater than the quantity needed for the expected duration of pain severe enough to require an opioid that is a controlled dangerous substance

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Fails to comply with the requirements of the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program under Title 21, Subtitle 2A of the Health – General Article.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into with all other states legally joining in it

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: The number of medical malpractice final court judgments and arbitration awards against the licensee within the most recent 10–year period.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Each hospital and related institution shall submit to the Board a report within 10 days after: The hospital or related institution denied the application of a physician for staff privileges or limited, reduced, otherwise changed, or terminated the staff privileges of a physician

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: "Physician Rehabilitation Program" means the program of the Board or the nonprofit entity with which the Board contracts under § 14–401.1(g) of this title that evaluates and provides assistance to impaired physicians and other health professionals regulated by the Board who are directed by the Board to receive treatment and rehabilitation for alcoholism, chemical dependency, or other physical, emotional, or mental conditions.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the Physician Rehabilitation Program may request the Board to direct, or the Board or a disciplinary panel on its own initiative may direct, the licensed physician or any allied health professional regulated by the Board under this title to submit to an appropriate examination.
